entries.title: Expiry cutoff test fails
entries.root_cause: LeaseExpiryTests.ExpiresAtCutoff expects true but receives false. The expiry behavior at the cutoff must satisfy the test.

entries.title: Referenced project is missing
entries.root_cause: Fallowspire references Ravelwort.Contracts.csproj at a path where it does not exist, leaving the Ravelwort namespace and ArchiveRecord type unresolved. Restore the referenced project or correct its path.

entries.title: Archive endpoint is not configured
entries.root_cause: The archive integration test requires the FALLOWSPIRE_ARCHIVE_URL environment variable, which the job does not provide. Configure the endpoint for the job.

entries.title: Expiry cutoff test fails
entries.root_cause: LeaseExpiryTests.ExpiresAtCutoff expects true but receives false. The expiry behavior at the cutoff must satisfy the test.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The later run uses SDK 9.0.101 instead of 8.0.404, a different runner and checkout, and has changed test counts, timings and source line numbers.
